mapper.select: select rp.order_id, rp.intervention_state, rp.expriation_time, rp.buyer_remarks, rp.buyer_voucher, rp.seller_voucher, rp.seller_remarks, sb.shop_name, rp.return_code, rp.shop_id, rp.application_time, rp.buyer_user_id, rp.seller_user_id, rp.return_state, rp.processing_results, rp.processing_time, rp.return_method_type, sb.retention_money_balance FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return_platform rp left join ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb on sb.supplier_shop_id = rp.shop_id where rp.order_id = #{orderId}

select oor.return_code, oor.order_id, oor.return_cash,oor.return_reason_id,oor.return_reason,oor.return_method_status, oor.return_rpt_cash, oor.return_commision_fee, oor.return_state, oor.return_add_time, oor.buyer_user_account,oor.revoke_num, oor.shop_name,oor.return_message,oor.shop_id,oor.buyer_user_id,oor.return_mobile, oor.return_member_discount,oor.close_time,oor.return_change_num, oor.expiration_time,oor.return_finish_time as returnFinishTime, oob.order_receiver_address,oob.order_receiver_contact FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob on oor.order_id = oob.order_id WHERE oor.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT rp.order_id, rp.return_code, rp.return_state, oor.order_seller_address, oor.order_seller_name, oor.order_seller_contact FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return_platform rp LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oor ON rp.order_id = oor.order_id WHERE rp.intervention_state = 0 AND rp.return_method_type = 3 AND now() > rp.expriation_time
